snippet.title: Project Thea Gameplay Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
COMING TO EARLY ACCESS NOVEMBER 20th!

Suit up for survival in Project Thea — a post-apocalyptic, retro-futuristic survival RPG with card combat, city-building, and Slavic demon mayhem. It’s gritty, it’s weird, and it’s got that sweet ‘90s vibe. Watch the gameplay now!

🕹️ Wishlist now on Steam:
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3360890/Project_Thea/

📬 Join the newsletter for updates, dev diaries & beta access:
